name: gemini-agentic-video-understanding-benchmark
title: PaperEdits Gemini Agentic Video Understanding Benchmark
description: Portable metadata for the frozen fixture manifest, eleven v0.4 result attempts, canonical five-pair aggregate, and deterministic paired uncertainty analysis. The exploratory sample does not establish statistical significance or general model superiority.

resources.name: fixtures

resources.description: Six synthetic ten-minute fixture records with rights declarations, source hashes, and frozen annotation paths.

resources.name: results
resources.title: Benchmark result attempts
resources.description: Eleven committed v0.4 attempts: five valid agentic/static pairs and one invalid agentic output.

resources.name: final-results
resources.title: Canonical five-pair aggregate
resources.description: Machine-readable aggregate for the five fixtures that produced valid agentic and static outputs.

resources.name: uncertainty
resources.title: Deterministic paired uncertainty analysis
resources.description: Exhaustive paired bootstrap intervals and exact sign-flip diagnostics for eight metrics.
